Specification: This module defines general-purpose utility operators for TLA+ specifications rather than a complete transition-system model with variables and a behavioral Spec. It provides helpers for set intersection testing, maximum and minimum selection from a set, reduction over sets and sequences, sequence indexing and manipulation, conversion from sequences to sets, an intersection operator over a set of sets, permutation generation for finite sets, and a small testing helper that prints a diagnostic when two values differ. The module has no state variables, no actions, and no temporal correctness properties; it is purely a library of state-level and mathematical operators built using sets, sequences, choice, recursion through finite-domain function definitions, and TLC's Print operator.
